entries.description_text: Standard-issue 7.62mm handgun with a 7-round clip. Alternate silenced mode.
The ultimate handgun. Devastating damage but requires loading after each shot.
Basic sidearm employed by Drake's forces. Not very accurate or lethal. Alternate 3-round burst mode.
Powerful, large-calibre handgun with a small clip. Some models have alternate laser sights which improve accuracy.
Light submachine gun firing 3-round bursts. Accurate, but doesn't carry much ammo. Alternate silenced mode.
A fully automatic machine pistol. Its large clip makes up for its low damage and accuracy.
Assault rifle with either telescopic sight or silencer. Alternate fire is laser-targeted for increased accuracy.
Advanced weapon system with a telescopic sight. Switch between a burst-firing rifle and a rapid-fire grenade launcher.
Combat shotgun, most effective at close range. Alternate rapid-fire mode is fast but very inaccurate.
Silenced military sniper rifle with incredible lethality. 5-round clip.
Military sniper rifle with incredible lethality. 5-round clip.
Drum-fed weapon firing high-explosive grenades on an arcing trajectory. Alternate mode sets grenades on a timer.
Military missile launcher that  allows you to steer the missile to target. Alternate mode rapid-fires unguided missiles.
Launches heat-seeking missiles that automatically track a target. Alternate mode fires unguided rockets.
Experimental Phoenix weapon capable of massive damage. Weapon must cool down if it overheats.
Explosive grenade that damages anyone within its blast radius. Useful against multiple enemies.
Produces a cloud of smoke that upsets enemy aim and cloaks your movement.
Temporarily blinds and stuns opponents, providing you with an opportunity to get away.
Contains plastic explosives which can be placed on an object and detonates on a timer. Alternate fire increases the time delay.
Small anti-personnel device that sticks to any surface. Switch to alternate fire to select the detonator: this will trigger any mines you have planted
Laser-activated bomb that explodes when someone crosses its beam.
Dual-weapon platform combines a rapid-fire 20mm cannon and a mini-rocket launcher.
Custom Q-designed infrared-guided missile system located in hidden compartments under the car hood.
Advanced torpedo system for use against underwater targets. Torpedoes are self-guided or can be set for remote-control.
A compact limpet mine that can be used to destroy underwater structures. Timed fuse.
Armoured sports-utility vehicle features a specially deployed missile / cannon platform.
20mm twin-barrel cannon combined with an advanced heat-seeking missile launcher.

entries.description_text: Discharges high voltage electrical current that temporarily knocks out opponents.
Lets you quietly cut through locks and hinges.
Shoots a high-tension wire which can be attached to special surfaces.
Provides magnified surveillance, the ability to photograph sensitive materials, and a bio-target designator.
A sophisticated micro-computer that allows you to bypass electronic locks.
Installs viral code that allows MI6 to retrieve data from foreign computer systems.
A remotely detonated grenade that temporarily blinds and stuns opponents.
An automated gun that will target enemies itself, or can be directly controlled by pressing Fire a second time.
Fires a powerful sedative-laced dart capable of tranquillising an opponent.
Alternate vision modes provide the ability to see opponents in the dark or through walls.
Rear-deployed smoke emission. Use this to throw enemies off your track.
Custom high-performance dual turbocharger adds significant acceleration when you need it most.
Hydraulic lift system raises the car onto two wheels. A good way to get out of a tight space.
Produces a high-energy electro-magnetic pulse that fries electronic systems. Stops enemy vehicles cold.
